import unittest

class Behavior(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_contract(self):
        from identifiers import same_part
        class PrintedCode(str):
            pass
        code = 'AX-014'
        separate = ''.join(['AX', '-', '014'])
        self.assertTrue(same_part(code, separate))
        self.assertTrue(same_part(PrintedCode(code), code))
        self.assertTrue(same_part(code, code))
        self.assertTrue(same_part('', ''))
        self.assertTrue(same_part('泵-七', ''.join(['泵','-','七'])))
        for other in ['ax-014', 'AX-014 ', ' AX-014', 'AX-015', '']:
            self.assertIs(same_part(code, other), False)
        self.assertIs(same_part(code, separate), True)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
